name: DFE Kafka
description: The broker's own view of the pipeline: topic sizes, consumer group lag, replication, and what is piling up in the dead letter queues.

config.name: Brokers
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT max(Value) AS "Brokers"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.brokers' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

config.name: Topics
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT count(DISTINCT Attributes['topic']) AS "Topics"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.topic.partitions' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

config.name: Total consumer lag
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT sum(latest) AS "Messages behind"
FROM (
  SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS latest
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.consumer_group.lag_sum' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY Attributes['group'], Attributes['topic']
)

config.name: Under-replicated partitions
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT countIf(replicas > in_sync) AS "Partitions"
FROM (
  SELECT Attributes['topic'] AS topic, Attributes['partition'] AS partition,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.replicas') AS replicas,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.replicas_in_sync') AS in_sync
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName IN ('kafka.partition.replicas', 'kafka.partition.replicas_in_sync')
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY topic, partition
)

config.name: Topic sizes and replication
config.sqlTemplate:
-- current minus oldest offset is what the broker is still holding, which is the
-- retention window in messages rather than the total ever produced.
SELECT topic AS "Topic",
       count() AS "Partitions",
       toUInt64(sum(current)) AS "Latest offset",
       toUInt64(sum(current - oldest)) AS "Messages retained",
       toUInt64(min(in_sync)) AS "Min in-sync replicas"
FROM (
  SELECT Attributes['topic'] AS topic, Attributes['partition'] AS partition,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.current_offset') AS current,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset') AS oldest
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('kafka.partition.current_offset', 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset')
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY topic, partition
) AS offsets
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT Attributes['topic'] AS topic, Attributes['partition'] AS partition,
         argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS in_sync
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.partition.replicas_in_sync' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY topic, partition
) AS replication USING (topic, partition)
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY "Messages retained" DESC

config.name: Consumer lag by group and topic
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(Attributes['group'], ' / ', Attributes['topic']) AS "Group and topic",
       max(Value) AS "Messages behind"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.consumer_group.lag_sum' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, Attributes['group'], Attributes['topic']
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Lag by partition (uneven lag means an uneven key)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(Attributes['topic'], '/', Attributes['partition']) AS "Partition",
       max(Value) AS "Messages behind"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.consumer_group.lag' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, Attributes['topic'], Attributes['partition']
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Consumer group members
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       Attributes['group'] AS "Group",
       max(Value) AS "Members"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.consumer_group.members' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, Attributes['group']
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Groups
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT Attributes['group'] AS "Group",
       Attributes['topic'] AS "Topic",
       toUInt64(argMax(Value, TimeUnix)) AS "Messages behind",
       toUInt64(max(Value)) AS "Worst in window"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.consumer_group.lag_sum' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY Attributes['group'], Attributes['topic']
ORDER BY "Messages behind" DESC

config.name: Messages produced per second, by topic
config.sqlTemplate:
-- Rate from the partition head offset: the broker publishes no produce counter,
-- so the offset's advance over the bucket IS the produce rate.
SELECT ts, topic AS "Topic", sum(advance) / $__interval_s AS "Messages/second"
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
         Attributes['topic'] AS topic,
         Attributes['partition'] AS partition,
         max(Value) - min(Value) AS advance
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.partition.current_offset' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, topic, partition
)
GROUP BY ts, topic
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Messages consumed per second, by group
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, grp AS "Group", sum(advance) / $__interval_s AS "Messages/second"
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
         Attributes['group'] AS grp,
         concat(Attributes['topic'], '/', Attributes['partition']) AS part,
         max(Value) - min(Value) AS advance
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'kafka.consumer_group.offset' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, grp, part
)
GROUP BY ts, grp
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Messages the broker is still holding
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, topic AS "Topic", sum(retained) AS "Messages retained"
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
         Attributes['topic'] AS topic,
         Attributes['partition'] AS partition,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.current_offset')
           - argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset') AS retained
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('kafka.partition.current_offset', 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset')
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, topic, partition
)
GROUP BY ts, topic
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Dead letter queue depth
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, topic AS "DLQ topic", sum(retained) AS "Messages"
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
         Attributes['topic'] AS topic,
         Attributes['partition'] AS partition,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.current_offset')
           - argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset') AS retained
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('kafka.partition.current_offset', 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset')
    AND Attributes['topic'] LIKE '%dlq%'
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, topic, partition
)
GROUP BY ts, topic
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Dead letter queues
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT topic AS "DLQ topic",
       toUInt64(sum(current - oldest)) AS "Messages held",
       toUInt64(sum(current)) AS "Ever written"
FROM (
  SELECT Attributes['topic'] AS topic, Attributes['partition'] AS partition,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.current_offset') AS current,
         argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset') AS oldest
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('kafka.partition.current_offset', 'kafka.partition.oldest_offset')
    AND Attributes['topic'] LIKE '%dlq%'
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY topic, partition
)
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY "Messages held" DESC
